interface.shortDescription: Goal-first team harness builder for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Oh My Goal is a Codex-native plugin skill that starts with a development objective, runs a deep interview, writes repo-local harness Markdown artifacts, recommends a create_goal prompt, and sets up Team-style evidence lanes plus anti-local-optimum pressure without requiring an omx launcher.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $oh-my-goal to interview me about what I want to build, create local harness files with team-style evidence lanes, and recommend the final Codex goal prompt.
